entries.title: Create validation accepts an empty content string
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts accepts content "" on create. It only checks typeof content === 'string', so an empty string passes and the note is created with empty content.

entries.title: Tag cap of 10 applies to create only, not update
entries.summary: validateCreateInput rejects more than MAX_TAGS (10) tags with a field 'tags' error, while validateUpdateInput has no tag-count limit, so PUT /api/notes/:id can set 11+ tags.

entries.title: Note titles have no maximum length
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts accepts a note title of any length on create. It only checks that the title is a string whose trimmed form is non-empty; no maximum-length check exists.
